name: 女童露肩V领短袖百褶裙两件套款

shots.intent: 搜索列表里一眼看清是一整套裙装而不是单件上衣，白底合规抢点击。
首屏一秒法则：把露肩V领配百褶短裙的整套造型力和头号卖点一次讲完。
shots.textZone: the diagonal ribbon holds one headline and one subline, the navy field below stays clean

shots.intent: 放大夏天童装最真实的两个摩擦，普通腰带勒腰、织面闷汗贴身，让家长在右格看到这套的解法。
shots.textZone: one short label line centered on each lower butter strip

shots.intent: 把整套放进家里试衣角的真实画面，高机位坐姿一次讲清裙摆蓬量与肩部松量。
一屏同时读到背板轮廓与镜中反射的斜排扣门襟与腰带，把正面拍不到的信息补全，降低退换。
shots.textZone: two small label chips along the top of the mirror edge, one per side

shots.intent: 三处结构近摄把斜领带、露肩袖口与织带腰头做成可见证据，回答磨不磨脖、勒不勒腰。
shots.textZone: one label line centered under each of the three panels

shots.intent: 用织面微距替掉空洞面料话术，肉眼看见纱线圈粒与露肩裁边车线，证明织面与做工。
同一屏看全源图所载三个配色的整套平铺，选色一步到位，降低因看不清颜色而退换的概率。
shots.textZone: one short colorway label slot on the header strip above each column

shots.intent: 把测量点位名称与尺码行做成结构化空白表格位，让家长按自家号型对照，数值一律不写死。
shots.textZone: one headline slot above the grid and six row titles, every value cell left blank

shots.intent: 用整块奶油色带上的圆形照片窗收一屏动起来的全身画面，低机位让裙摆有风，把情绪价值补足。
shots.textZone: one small hand-lettered tag taped at the lower edge of the circle

shots.intent: 详情页最后一步收口：整套挂装加三色折叠色卡位与圆角按钮，把逛完的细节转成选码下单动作。
shots.textZone: headline field on the navy above the set, one short button label inside the red ribbon

style.backgroundSystem: matte photo-paper sweep #FFFFFF for packshots and construction close-ups; navy poster field #232A4E behind the opening poster, the comparison screen and the closing screen; tomato-red #D93A2B only ever as one diagonal headline ribbon or one rounded button shape, never as a full field; butter section band #FBF3C0 carrying the spec screen and the circular photo window; the fitting-corner interior with paneled wall #F1EFEA, linen bench #7E9AB8 and grey marble floor #C8C6C3 only inside the worn lifestyle screens; one flat block per screen, never a gradient and never a hue outside this list
style.direction: color-block scrapbook kids apparel commerce, poster-grade flat blocking with taped white-matted photo cards and clean infographic discipline
style.iconSystem: single-weight line icons in #232A4E plus two hand-drawn doodle stickers, one crown outline and one four-point sparkle, in #D93A2B, sticker style only on the two lifestyle screens; no filled emblems, no seal realism, no certificate artwork, no badge wording
style.lightingSystem: neutral daylight-balanced 5500K key from the upper left, large softbox diffusion with a bounce fill on the shadow side, true contact shadow under every hem and every taped card edge, one long soft grounded shadow on the interior screens, no harsh speculars, no warm cast and no cool cast
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent color-block scrapbook children's apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of matte photo-paper white #FFFFFF, navy poster field #232A4E, one tomato-red block #D93A2B used only as a diagonal headline ribbon or button shape, and a butter section band #FBF3C0; neutral daylight-balanced 5500K lighting with an upper-left softbox key, bounce fill and true contact shadows under every hem and every card edge; one heavy geometric sans for all labels plus one hand-lettered script reserved for two small decorative tags; background system of paper sweep #FFFFFF, navy field #232A4E, tomato-red ribbon #D93A2B, butter band #FBF3C0 and a fitting-corner interior with paneled wall #F1EFEA, linen bench #7E9AB8 and grey marble floor #C8C6C3; single-weight line icons in #232A4E with two doodle stickers in #D93A2B; white-matted photo cards taped with one strip of masking tape; the cold-shoulder top and the pleated skirt always read as one set at stable scale, every worn frame cropped from the neck down so no child face appears, and garment graphic zones named structurally and never redrawn; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no color palette changes and no new accent hues
no mixed fonts, no serif or retro faces beyond the one decorative script tag
no random backgrounds, no outdoor street scenery and no real storefronts
no inconsistent lighting direction and no missing contact shadows
no mismatched icon styles and no invented badge artwork
no identifiable child face, no teen or adult proportions and no adult styling on children's garments
no redrawn garment graphics, no third-party character marks and no duplicated print panels
style.presentationRules: the cold-shoulder top and the pleated skirt always read as one set at one scale across screens; every worn frame is a generic child body cropped from the neck down or seen from behind so no identifiable face ever appears; the angled neckline graphic zone, the two small sleeve graphic zones, the diagonal front button placket and the threaded woven belt are named structurally and never redrawn; flat cards stay square to the frame and hung sets stay centred
style.surfaceSystem: matte photo-paper #FFFFFF used as the card mat, brushed navy board #232A4E for poster fields, butter paper #FBF3C0 for section bands, washed linen bench #7E9AB8 and grey marble floor #C8C6C3 only inside the fitting-corner screens; garment faces stay flat, unwrinkled and lint-free, no debris in frame
style.typography: one heavy geometric sans for every Chinese and Latin label plus one relaxed hand-lettered script reserved for two small decorative tags on the lifestyle screens and never used on a factual label; in-image Chinese always appears as 「{selling_point_N}」 or 「{callout_N}」; headline 28-48pt, subline 16-20pt, label 10-14pt, per-screen copy budget under 50 characters; every photo card is square-cornered with a wide white mat and one strip of masking tape, one card may sit tilted on the band
